title: Data manifest
description: Generated inventory of the fixed installation layout for backup/restore, not path configuration. Components do not relocate data. Paths are relative to data_dir except memory.facts, which is relative to the instance live root. Older descriptive manifests remain readable.

data_dir.description: Absolute path of the ummanu-data directory.

components.description: Locations recorded by the product. Editing these fields does not change the paths used by readers or writers.

path.description: Derived memory files directory, relative to data_dir.

facts.description: Canonical Markdown facts at state/memory/facts, relative to the instance live root, not data_dir. Older manifests may describe the retired memory/facts layout; the manifest does not migrate or configure it.

export.description: Derived NDJSON snapshot at memory/export.ndjson, relative to data_dir.

index.description: Derived SQLite index at memory/index.sqlite, relative to data_dir; rebuilt from facts.
